prompt:

Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.

text: The council is launching an all-out war on residents next month, and they’ve authorized aggressive patrols to slap massive, ruinous fines on anyone whose bin is even a minute late. They are hunting for every single violator, so expect total enforcement across every street.
